Projects.description: A selection of deployed machine learning applications, dashboards, and scalable full-stack architectures.

01.title: Plant Disease Detection
01.desc: Production-style leaf disease classifier served through a lightweight Hugging Face Spaces FastAPI deployment with multipart uploads, EfficientNet-B0 inference, top-5 confidence analysis, Grad-CAM explanations, webcam capture, and local analytics.

02.title: AI Financial Analyst
02.desc: Enterprise-grade financial intelligence platform orchestrated by 5 specialized AI agents (Researcher, Quant, Auditor, Competitor, Editor) with PyTorch Neural Chart Vision, live portfolio rebalancing, social sentiment feeds, and XAI explainability.

03.title: AI Interview Analyzer
03.desc: Browser-native interview practice module with live speech capture, transcript scoring, answer feedback, and interactive coaching UI integrated directly into the ML Lab experience.

04.title: Skin Disease Detection
04.desc: Medical-image demo for skin lesion classification with image upload, CNN inference, risk-oriented result panels, top-5 predictions, and clinical-style confidence breakdowns.

05.title: Emotion Detection
05.desc: Text understanding module that predicts primary emotion, gender, and age signals with ranked scores, confidence bars, examples, and history inside the shared ML Lab interface.

06.title: Spam Detection
06.desc: SMS-style spam classifier with ham/spam probability scoring, keyword surfacing, confidence visualizations, sample prompts, and production API integration patterns.

07.title: Sentiment Analysis
07.desc: Deployed sentiment model for positive, negative, and neutral text classification with confidence scores, class distribution bars, examples, and prediction history.

08.title: AI Trading CoPilot
08.desc: Build, Backtest, Monitor and Improve Trading Strategies using natural language, autonomous validation, market context analysis, event-driven backtesting, paper trading, and real-time drift detection.

09.title: Live Trading Dashboard
09.desc: Phase 5 Live Trading Dashboard consuming EnterpriseMarketCache, SingleFlight Request Coordinator, Streaming Consensus, and AI Strategy Coach with live watchlists, provider health matrices, and telemetry meters.
